What a person does where the judge did not ask at the verdict, or where they declined at the time and later changed their mind. The controlling review presumes the non-conviction petition track and this memo routes there, which is consistent with § 40-32-106(a)(1) listing a verdict of not guilty among the grounds for a petition-based free expunction. The presumption was not confirmed against an official statement of practice.

The section's operative status is confirmed by official cross-reference from the enacted text of Public Chapter 268, at § 40-32-102(c)(2) and § 40-32-106(c)(1), and Public Chapter 268 §§ 11 and 12 amended it. Nothing about the mechanism is asserted, and the node detects and refers only.
